name: anchor: cursor searches — email & licensing & integrations
description: Cursor walks (limit 2) inside a throwaway product: the audit log of an SMTP integration (create, disable, reconfigure while disabled, so nothing dials smtp.example.com), three email templates with one name (default order and sort_by name, all tie), three license templates, the licenses of three organizations with one name (organization_name order ties) and the history of one license (instantiated, adjusted twice). Email sends need a reachable mail server: one empty page and a malformed cursor. Each walk must return the reference page's rows in order, once each, with next_cursor until the last page. The audit log asserts the 400 INVALID_CURSOR refusals. Deleting the product (always) removes everything; its 404 is verified.
